reviews.name: Christina Liew
reviews.text:
I had been living with neck, shoulder and lower back pain for many years before I started training with Shaun. What stood out to me was how he took the time to understand my body and pinpoint the specific issues, rather than simply putting me through a standard workout.
He identified the different muscles that needed to be strengthened, worked on them individually, and then helped me learn how to coordinate them properly. Over time, this has made a real difference to my everyday mobility and how I feel physically.
I have been training with Shaun for over a year now, and I am genuinely in a much better physical state—with greater strength, endurance and confidence in my movement.
I am very grateful for his knowledge, patience and personalised approach. I highly recommend Shaun to anyone looking for a thoughtful and effective functional training coach.

reviews.name: Yuanhong Tan
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Jensen! I’ve been training with him for over 1.5 years, and his approach to personal training is incredibly refreshing. He focuses entirely on overall lifestyle, long-term well-being, and injury prevention rather than just chasing aesthetic body shapes or heavy gym metrics.
What I appreciate most is how dialed-in he is to my current physical state. During my half-marathon prep, he adjusted our training items based on my running volume and recovery. When work gets intense and I'm sitting for too long, he immediately pivots to target office posture and muscle tightness. Jensen is the perfect fit for anyone who wants to feel better, move better, and live a healthier, pain-free life.

reviews.name: Suyeon Koo
reviews.text: I used to train with Tan Long for general fitness and strength training, so I knew he specialises in chronic pain and has a lot of experience working with older adults. When my mother-in-law (69) continued to struggle with knee pain despite having received PRP injections for meniscus tears and early osteoarthritis, I didn't hesitate to bring her to him. What stood out was how he assessed her whole body rather than just the knees, quickly identifying that poor hip and ankle function was overloading her joints. He explained everything clearly, and by the end of the session she was already moving more comfortably with a practical program to follow at home. Having trained with him myself, I'd recommend him without hesitation — especially for older adults dealing with persistent or complex pain.

reviews.name: Leng
reviews.text:
This was my first session with Shaun Lim, and it gave me confidence in his professional capability. He demonstrated a sound understanding of muscle function and movement mechanics, and was able to identify posture and movement issues through observation and assessment. He explained his findings clearly and recommended exercises that addressed the likely underlying causes rather than simply treating the symptoms.
He was patient and systematic throughout the session, taking time to go through the exercises repeatedly to ensure I understood the correct movement patterns. His demonstrations were clear, and he paid close attention to technique, making corrections where necessary.
He also listened carefully to what I described about my condition and incorporated it into his assessments and recommendations.
For a first session, I felt it established a clear understanding of the issues to work on and a practical direction for addressing them. I left with a better understanding of my movement patterns and the exercises I should focus on going forward.

reviews.name: aditi rungta
reviews.text: Jenson is a fantastic trainer who combines deep expertise with genuine care for his clients. I particularly appreciate his holistic approach to fitness, his ability to tailor workouts to different bodies and needs, and his strong knowledge of anatomy and injury prevention. He's disciplined, passionate, and incredibly resourceful - always finding effective alternatives when needed. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: YC Lau
reviews.text:
I first started training with Tan Long in Nov 2023, hoping to address my long-standing lower back and shoulder/neck issues that causes pain frequently and limits my range of motion. He was able to pinpoint and provide helpful information to the underlying issues and from there, designed a targeted training plan. He worked on those areas effectively and consistently pushes me to challenge my limits. Tan Long is also always generous to share his knowledge, which enhances insights to my body and more capable of managing my own health conditions.
The training with Edmund began in April 2024. His approach has been a perfect complement. He brings along his own areas of expertise, with a gentle, empathetic style that makes the sessions feel both encouraging and productive. He paces the training in a way that is manageable—without ever slowing down the progress. He is also skilled with muscle tensions release that helps to make the training more effective.
Grateful to both Tan Long and Edmund, for often going the extra mile to educate and build knowledge. They focus not only in physical health but also the impact that mental health brings, which definitely help improve my overall body and mind awareness. I now have a much better understanding of my body, improved strength, and a noticeably wider range of motion. I perform exercises more efficiently, feel more in control of my movements, and even managed to achieve a full toe touch—something I have never been able to do since I was young.
Thank you Tan Long and Edmund, for your constant sharing of knowledge, your attentiveness and genuinely committed to helping us improve.

reviews.name: Min Koh
reviews.text:
Before working with Coach Tan Long, I was constantly battling pain—my left hip/foot tension kept me from sleeping through the night, and my left knee ached when I climbed stairs. After just a few months of his personalized training, these issues are gone. I can now sleep soundly and climb stairs pain-free!
As someone who practices advanced yoga (arm balances, handstands, deep backbends and splits), I frequently ran into frustrating aches and pains. Coach Tan Long is incredibly insightful. He assessed my Range of Motion (ROM), taught me specific targeted workouts, and meticulously checked my body's adaptation. He was able to pinpoint the root cause and effectively relieve the tension.
Over the past three months, I’ve seen remarkable improvements in my foundation, including better overall posture (reduced anterior pelvic tilt and knee hyperextension). My squats have improved considerably, and I no longer rely on lower back compensation.
Coach Tan Long is a must-see PT Coach for anyone who wants to improve their quality of life, daily function, or athletic performance. For those of us, like me, who need to understand the Why’s (science & logic) behind the assessment, exercise, adjustment - he is absolutely the best resource available!

reviews.name: Elaine
reviews.text:
I’ve been seeing Hans for 12 sessions to work on my knee issues and I’m thankful for the progress so far. He focuses a lot on proper realignment and improving my movement patterns rather than just treating the pain temporarily.
Through the sessions, he helped me understand how my body moves and what may be causing stress on my knees. The exercises were practical, targeted, and adjusted according to my condition each time. I also appreciate that he explains things clearly and makes sure I’m doing the movements correctly so that I don’t aggravate the pain.
Overall, I feel more confident moving and exercising without hurting my knees further. Highly recommend Hans to anyone dealing with pain issues or wanting to improve their movement safely!

reviews.name: Jeanne Tan
reviews.text: Shaun at ReGen Performance is an incredibly attentive Personal Trainer who truly understands the needs of a 'young elderly' client like myself. Before jumping into weights, he took the time to test my mobility and identify my weak points. I was surprised when he prioritised flexibility and functional movement over the 'vain' muscle-building goals I initially had, but I’m so glad he did. He built a custom program that actually addresses what my body needs to stay mobile. I’ve already recommended him to friends and will continue to do so. Keep up the great work, Shaun!

reviews.name: Steph Gee
reviews.text: I’ve found Isaac to be incredibly attentive, and he tailors his functional training very thoughtfully to address where I’m weak while helping me build the strength needed to stay healthy and age well. He is constantly upgrading his knowledge and skills, which gives me a lot of confidence in how he manages and advises on my condition. I would highly recommend him, especially for anyone with pre-existing conditions who wants a safe, well-considered approach to training.

reviews.name: Yvonne Tan
reviews.text: Tan Long is a very patient and detailed PT and has good knowledge of the body anatomy. I was looking for a PT as I have a nagging left knee pain which came on early this year. In the 1st consultation, he did various assessments and tests to narrow down what are the possible reasons and root cause of my knee pain. He prescribed some exercises for me to do and over few weeks, it helped me get rid of the knee pain. I liked that he was very thorough and his ability to connect the dots to try to find out the root cause and not simply just zoom in to the knee where my pain was. He was always very professional and encouraging and this helped me gained the confidence to continue with my workouts safely.

reviews.name: Jamie Lim
reviews.text:
I’ve had the privilege of training with Shaun, and I can honestly say he’s unlike any personal trainer I’ve worked with before—in the best way possible.
Rather than following a one-size-fits-all routine, Shaun takes a thoughtful and targeted approach. He focuses on strengthening the muscles that truly matter for me, especially those supporting my aching knees. It’s clear that every exercise has a purpose, and I’ve started to feel real improvements in both stability and comfort.
What really sets him apart is his dedication beyond the session itself. After each workout, he sends detailed notes and even pictures to help me remember the exercises and maintain proper form. That extra effort makes a huge difference and shows how invested he is in his clients’ progress.
If you’re looking for someone who listens, adapts, and genuinely cares about long-term results—not just quick wins—Shaun is the trainer to go to.

reviews.name: Dina Rizvic
reviews.text: I’ve had several sessions with Isaac, and they’ve been incredibly helpful in understanding my body, improving my technique, and building strength. He is supportive, patient, and knowledgeable, and his follow-up notes and videos make it easy to continue training independently. I’d highly recommend him to anyone looking to build strong foundations or take their training to the next level.

reviews.name: KALOS ONG
reviews.text:
Han's style is warm and personable. He is very knowledgeable about bodily pains and the right approaches to rectify and improve the conditions.
After 4 sessions under his guidance, I have improved my physical fitness and understood some important steps to alleviate my body pains (especially those arising from Sciatica).
I highly recommend training under Hans.

reviews.name: Ng Hong Wei
reviews.text:
I use to do muay thai and heavy squats and have realise left lateral outside knee pain during climbing of stairs. Tan long was very effectively in realising i can not slow down my left footing when i do a step up, after your checking on my feet.
He gave me some exercises that help me to regain my left side foot. He also shared some ideas that my rectus femoris should be trained, also my calves can be stretched more. I tried and immediately i feel lighter. I am excited to include those exercises in my own training. Definitely would trust that one is in good hands under his coaching. My foot has abit more range now as well, that is quick for someone with foot as stiff as mine.

reviews.name: Nick Yeo
reviews.text:
I have been training with Coach Issac for more than a year now and he is very conscientious, hardworking, and diligent during every session. He always watches my form closely and corrects me to make sure I am doing the exercises properly and safely.
He takes my goals seriously and plans each workout around what I want to achieve instead of following a fixed routine. He is also constantly improving his knowledge, attending courses, working towards his degree in osteopathy and trying different approaches to training, so the sessions never feel repetitive. We get a lot done within an hour and every session feels productive.
I would definitely recommend Isaac to anyone looking for a trainer who is focused, professional, and truly cares about the process and of course, results!

reviews.name: Li Hao Tan
reviews.text: Shaun is absolutely professional and offers great advice! I have a lot of muscle tightness in my back and legs from just sitting behind a desk. These are promptly relieve from a massage session with Shaun and he offers tips and stretches which are effective every time I feel stiffness in my back. Thank you for helping me feel better and more motivated to exercise!

reviews.name: Derek Low
reviews.text: Have been working out under Kennard’s guidance for more than a year now. I am not a very active person but with Ken’s help I can see my weight and health improved body composition has also improved. He also uses apps to interface with my weighting machine and other health devices to all us to track and monitor my progress. Will continue to work with him to continue improving and maintaining my fitness level.

reviews.name: Sophie
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Coach Kennard to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and supportive personal trainer.
What sets him apart is his deep understanding of injury recovery and his ability to create personalised training programs. Every workout is carefully customised to suit my body's limitations from old lower back and knee injuries, allowing me to train safely while still making steady progress.
With his guidance, I achieved my goals of performing clean pull-ups and mastering proper push-up form something I never thought I'd be able to do with confidence.
Coach Kennard knows exactly when to push me to improve, but more importantly, he knows when to pull me back to prevent injuries. His genuine care for his clients, combined with his expertise, makes every training session both effective and enjoyable.
If you're looking for a trainer who truly understands your needs and is invested in your long term progress, I can't recommend Coach Kennard enough.

reviews.name: Lim Feng
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Shaun Lim for his professionalism & expertise. He designed a safe & effective program for my knee injury that helped me to rebuild strength & learn the correct exercises for my body. I can feel my knees are getting stronger ! His expertise & attention made all the difference in my recovery.
Appreciate your encouragement & making sure I am doing what’s right for my body 🤗👏👍

reviews.name: Mao Gen Foo
reviews.text: I have a weaken left knee due to service injury over 30years. Despited seeing different Physio & PTs over the course of time, my condition did not improve. Shaun has been able to help reduce pain, gain strength & flexibility by tailoring each session based on my condition; and providing detail instructions for self workout during travels & non-training days. Highly recommend Shaun, especially for those with mobility challenges to fix.

reviews.name: Zhi Ming Chng (Jim)
reviews.text: I was experiencing a persistent lower backache which did not resolve itself even with more rest for close to a month. Fortunately, I was referred to Issac who identified that my condition was due to a weak core and he treated me during my first visit, which alleviated the pain eventually. Issac also prepared and guided me through a series of exercises to strengthen my core and legs, which improved my condition subsequently with practice and so far there has been no relapses. This gave me confidence in Issac's expertise and I highly recommend Issac for all looking to improve your exercise forms and routine.

reviews.name: J M
reviews.text:
I’ve been doing physio and mobility work with Edmund at Regen Performance, and it’s been a game changer. He really opened my eyes to how everything in the body is connected — starting from the feet all the way up.
What stood out most is how he was able to identify the root cause of my pain instead of just treating the surface symptoms like what most physiotherapists practice. Once he addressed that, the pain went away completely, and my mobility improved drastically.
Edmund’s approach is both detailed and holistic — he helps you understand how your body works and teaches you how to move better for the long term. I feel lighter, more stable, and more aware of my movement now.
Highly recommend Regen Performance to anyone dealing with pain, stiffness, or wanting to move and feel better overall.

reviews.name: Emre Tanrivere
reviews.text: I have been trained by Shaun for nearly 4 months, he has a very positive, respectfull, professional, flexible and motivating attitude, Analyze your body & limits and design exactly which is best for you based on your life style for a tailormade program. After 4 months exceptional gain based on my expectations, solved many problems and put gains on top of. Will continue on our training during my presence in Singapore.

reviews.name: Ming
reviews.text:
I was struggling with intractable chronic pain for over a year — pain so intense and persistent that it completely disrupted my daily life.
I’m deeply grateful to have subsequently found Issac. My recovery journey was far from linear though, and there were periods when my condition actually worsened. Through it all, Issac remained patient and supportive. He consistently checked in between sessions and thoughtfully adjusted my rehabilitation exercises to match my changing needs.
Issac also takes the extra step of documenting and recording each prescribed exercise, sending me the videos for easy reference. This has been incredibly helpful in ensuring that I practice them correctly and consistently.
Thanks to his expertise and dedication, I’ve been able to gradually regain strength, confidence, and a sense of normalcy. Working with Issac has truly helped me reclaim my quality of life.

reviews.name: Stephan van Alphen
reviews.text: Having trained with Hans now for 3 months and he has been able to significantly reduce my lower back pain that I had been dealing with for years. He combines a strong PT foundation with deep understanding of the human body and applies a holistic approach to improving overall fitness, strength and health!

reviews.name: Siew Lian Tay
reviews.text:
For months, knee osteoarthritis made everyday activities a struggle. Walking short distances, squatting, climbing stairs, and even turning in bed caused pain and swelling. I tried TCM treatments and medication for pain relief but the relief never lasted. Meeting Tan Long changed all these.
He did a thorough assessment and showed me how to reduce the inflammation in my knee. With his targetted rehabilitation exercises, the swelling eased noticeably within a week and I could walk more comfortably again.
What sets Tan Long apart is his patience and attention to detail. He always corrects my form, makes sure I move safely and gently pushes me to improve without ever making me feel rushed. Thanks to his persistence, I regained more flexibility, mobility and strength.
Today, I can walk, squat and climb stairs without difficulty. I am now continuing to work with him to build stronger legs, glutes and arms so that I can get even stronger overall.
I am grateful for Tan Long's expertise, dedication and genuine care. Highly recommend him for anyone looking for a knowledgeable and results-driven personal trainer!

reviews.name: Jona Kwong
reviews.text:
Hans has been an excellent personal trainer. He’s very diligent and always sends detailed training summaries after each session, which helps me track my progress. Our first session focused on understanding my body including my neck aches and other issues before tailoring the workouts to my needs.
Since then, we’ve been doing a mix of gym exercises and home routines. I really appreciate his attention to detail and encouragement. I’m already feeling fitter and stronger thanks to his guidance.

reviews.name: agnes lim
reviews.text:
I’m truly delighted to share my experience working with my personal trainer, Tan Long. When I first started, I never imagined that just a few sessions could make such a profound difference. Yet very quickly, I found myself moving without my knee guard, no longer depending on painkillers, and gaining back a sense of normalcy I had long forgotten.
What stands out most about Tan is the way he genuinely invests in the people he trains. His dedication goes far beyond conducting a workout—he consistently checks in, follows up, and makes sure I’m coping well both physically and mentally. It’s clear that improving the quality of life for his clients is truly important to him.
The early stages of training weren’t easy; I had years of knee discomfort and occasional setbacks. But Tan remained patient, encouraging, and always ready to adjust the programme so I could progress safely. His blend of expertise and compassion helped build a strong trust between us, and I soon began looking forward to every session.
Today, I am able to walk up to 20,000 steps comfortably, without pain or hesitation—something I would have considered impossible not long ago. Whether travelling or going about my day, I now enjoy a sense of freedom and mobility I haven’t felt in years. On top of that, I’ve grown noticeably stronger and am now able to perform multiple repetitions of bodyweight squats—another milestone that once felt completely out of reach.
I even managed to stand and walk throughout a major work event, an achievement that once seemed impossible after seven years of persistent knee issues and discussions about surgery. Friends and colleagues have noticed the difference too, often commenting that I seem more energetic and happier. This progress is a testament to Tan’s guidance and unwavering support.
I’m deeply grateful for the transformation I’ve experienced under Tan Long’s care. If you’re seeking a trainer who is knowledgeable, attentive, and truly committed to helping you regain your confidence and strength, Tan is someone I wholeheartedly recommend.

reviews.name: Shann Chiu
reviews.text: Had been doing rehab sessions with Issac. He’s very patient and knowledgeable. Knee pain improved after sessions and strengthening exercises. Would highly recommend to seek his consultation

reviews.name: Joanne Pizel
reviews.text: I've been working out with Issac and Hans from ReGen Performance for over 3 years and they are the BEST! They have made me adore strength training💪. They know so much more than typical trainers about how the body works and how to modify movements based on my specific anatomy and flexibility etc. They are both training as Oesteopaths in their spare time as they are just so passionate about how to improve their clients outcomes. I'm a 51 year old female and am stronger and fitter than I've ever been in my life. I feel great and know that a huge part of it is because of these two trainers. I've seen the other ReGen trainers with their clients too and they seem fantastic as well. I would 100% recommend!

reviews.name: Jason Goh
reviews.text:
I have been training Muay Thai for some time and, I kept getting this sharp heel pain whenever I kicked, especially during harder pad rounds and it really affected my power and confidence.
I went to Tan Long for help, and as always, he was extremely detailed, patient, and generous with his guidance. He took the time to assess my technique, pinpointed exactly what was causing the heel pain, and gave me specific adjustments and drills. The difference was immediate, by the end of the session, I could kick with much less discomfort and felt much more confident.
This isn’t my first time seeing him. A few years back, I had a shoulder separation injury and couldn’t even lift my right arm properly. Tan Long was the one who identified the root issue and gave me precise exercises to reduce the pain. Over time, I managed to get back to my usual self without that lingering shoulder problem.
What I’ve always found valuable is how personalised his approach is. He doesn’t give generic advice, he explains clearly and tailors everything to your body and movement. He genuinely wants to help you get better.
I would definitely recommend Tan Long to anyone in martial arts or dealing with nagging pain. He’s helped me twice now, and both times I walked away feeling better.

reviews.name: Renee Foo
reviews.text: When I started jogging after decades of inactivity, I found that my knees hurt. I went to Tan Long from ReGen and he patiently guided me to improve my balance and build strength in my legs and core through many varied exercises for me which included weights. I appreciated that after each session, he gave me follow-up exercises to do at home without any equipment. He also checked in with me constantly to find out if I had any muscle aches after training. After training with him consistently, I am now much stronger and I am able to lift heavier weights. To my happiness, not only am I able to jog, I am able to trek up and down steep inclines without my knees hurting at all. I feel more energetic as well. I highly recommend Tan Long and his fellow ReGen trainers to anyone who is looking for physical trainers as they are patient, knowledgeable, clear in their explanations about the purpose of each exercise, very encouraging, and most importantly, deliver good results.

reviews.name: Su
reviews.text: I look forward to my training sessions with my trainer, Hans :) He takes great care to make sure that his program for me takes into account my structural shortfalls whilst working towards my long-term fitness goals. Every session is varied and pushes me just above my comfort zone. Hans is also trained in rehabilitative fitness and currently undergoing osteopathic training too, so when I had a recent neck issue, he was able to help me with it. It was truly helpful. As a person, Hans is ever-encouraging, always carries a smile and laughs easily. He creates a happy time at the gym. I’m very grateful to have found a great trainer.

reviews.name: jasmine ang
reviews.text:
My trainer Edmund from ReGen Performance is very professional.
He takes effort to understand his client’s physical needs and he tailored right exercises for his client to correct body alignments and right body movement to strengthen the weak muscles and correct the body alignment.
Every session , he will plan varieties of exercises and instill fun way to do it -
He is very encouraging during the training.
He is very patience and explain step by step clearly on how to do it especially to me considering my age and will immediately let me know whenever I did not do it right.
After the training sessions , feel refreshed and … areas eg arms , buttock , leg muscles etc become stronger and more flexible.

reviews.name: Ryan Koh
reviews.text:
I had issues with unstable feet while squatting, but Tan Long was very helpful in guiding me through the right stretches and correcting my form. I found his explanations simple and easy to understand, which made the session enjoyable and not overwhelming.
What I really valued was learning the proper technique and the importance of stretching to improve stability – it’s something I can apply even outside of the session. The training has definitely helped me feel more confident and stable during my squats.
I’d definitely recommend Tan Long to my family and friends who want clear guidance and effective coaching.

reviews.name: Roz
reviews.text:
I’ve been training with Isaac from ReGen Performance and couldn’t be more pleased with the results. He is extremely patient, professional, and knowledgeable — not just in personal training, but also trained in muscle function and osteopathy. His understanding of body mechanics allows him to customise my workouts to strengthen weak areas, manage pain effectively, and improve my overall stability.
Since starting training with him, I feel significantly stronger, more confident, and much more aware of my body. The improvement is noticeable not only to me but also to people around me! Isaac genuinely cares about his clients’ progress and ensures every session is both safe and effective. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a trainer who truly knows what he’s doing and tailors every detail to help you reach your goals.

reviews.name: Caruna Sothi
reviews.text: I have been training with Hans for a few years now and really appreciate how he tailors each session to suit my needs. His tips on how to keep good form while doing the exercises and how to activate/rehabiltate muscles, etc are effective and easy to understand/apply. At the end of each session I feel good about my fitness level and am inspired to keep going.

reviews.name: Qing Xia Boo
reviews.text: Edmund- This has been an outstanding experience, and your attentive coaching style is greatly appreciated. I especially value how you consistently check on my progress and adjust our sessions accordingly. Your helpful guidance has been instrumental in alleviating the persistent pain in my heels and shoulder. I am already feeling significant improvements and much stronger. Thank you for your expert support and genuine care.

reviews.name: Kendrick Chng
reviews.text: Is great and fortune that I met Issac. He help me tremendously to when I am suffer from spill disc. He is still coaching me to improve my overall fitness so that this injury will nt be back again

reviews.name: Gan B.
reviews.text: I experienced a remarkable recovery from shoulder pain thanks to Shaun's session. The techniques he taught are incredibly effective!

reviews.name: Lim Wei
reviews.text:
I m great to hv Shaun as my personal trainer, recently I hurt lower back. Slowly, with his training schedule, my back pain slowly getting better... Will continue to train under him.
Great Thanks.

reviews.name: Agnes Chong
reviews.text: Issac is a dedicated and responsible coach. Every session is tailored to specific objectives. He has helped me to build key muscles and endurance, to train more effectively for my half marathon.

reviews.name: Edmund Sin
reviews.text: I enrolled my dad in a program with Tan Long to address his lower limb weakness and limited mobility following a partial knee replacement last year. We had previously tried massages and TCM, but the improvements were only temporary. Through comprehensive physical assessments and Tan Long’s extensive experience, we were able to identify specific areas of weakness and focus our efforts there. His movement and balance have noticeably improved since. I highly recommend Tan Long for anyone seeking a knowledgeable and experienced trainer.

reviews.name: Lee Amy
reviews.text:
Was highly recommended by a personal friend to seek Tan Long for his help in my hip/ knee pain. During my 1st session, Long gave me a thorough assessment before addressing my issues. From the assessment I become aware of the way I stand (tendency to lean forward ) that shows weakness in my calves and hamstrings . Since then I try to do self correction in my walk by engaging my calves muscle more and not lean forward.
He also introduces exercises to address my hip pain. Though the exercises seem easy , they have proven to be very effective ! I found much relief in my daily walks while away on 2 wks holidays recently. For the 1st time in all my travels , I experienced no pain and was able to walk the whole day clocking average of 13k steps each day with little difficulty.
Looking forward to more sessions with Tan Long to strengthen my muscles for greater improvement and agility.
Thank u Long !!

reviews.name: Sara Teo
reviews.text: Shaun creates a space that feels "not over-whelming" especially for 1st timer. He is able to help to alleviate stress and anxiety during sessions. Short video clips are taken for self-correction.

reviews.name: Natalie Koh
reviews.text: I had my first trial session and I already learnt a lot from Shaun! I appreciated his attention to detail and the depth of his knowledge that he shared with me.

reviews.name: Nasirdah Syed Mohd
reviews.text: Hans is a great trainer, he gives practical support and weekly feedback to carry out the activities at the home setting. He motivates his clients to keep on practicing the exercises he taught to them. Thank you Hans

reviews.name: Teo Jordan
reviews.text: Very good treatment by Tan Long!!! Helped my dad with his knee joint issue and movement limitations. Provided advice and visible improvements observed just over a single session

reviews.name: yapgy001
reviews.text: Been with Issac for three years, patient and meticulous in his approach. Will definitely recommend 👍

reviews.name: Lyanrd Tang
reviews.text: Learn and gain alot of rehab knowledge from Coach Issac. Couple training are available too. Best in the town

reviews.name: Toh Hong seng
reviews.text: The place was well equipped, brightly lighted and comfortable.

reviews.name: Aiting Lin
reviews.text:
I started training with Tan Long because I was experiencing pain in my hips, knees and heels. I also used to develop blisters on my toes whenever I walked for a few hours, which made longer walks uncomfortable.
Through the training, we worked on improving my strength, mobility and the way I move. I’m very happy that my hip and knee pain have now resolved, and even the problem with blisters on my toes has recovered. We are now focusing on improving my heel pain.
What I value most is that the sessions are personalised to my needs. The exercises are practical and purposeful, and I understand better how strengthening different parts of my body can help with my everyday movement.
I enjoy the variety of the training and being challenged progressively while still feeling safe and well guided. It’s very encouraging to see the improvements over time!
I would definitely recommend the training to my friends and family, especially anyone who wants to improve their strength and mobility, manage aches and pains, and stay active as they get older. 😊

reviews.name: Aarthi Parthiban
reviews.text: Qaila has a very warm and bubbly personality. She is such a great personal trainer and explained every step very well. I highly recommend her for any stage of your fitness journey!!!!

reviews.name: Petrina Soh
reviews.text: Came here for a visit with my 6 year old who has early onset scoliosis. Tan Long was straightforward and detailed in his explanations. He is very knowledgeable and it was easy to understand his approach and perspective. He provided a calm and relaxing atmosphere and my son was very willing to work with him. I am grateful that he taught me simple exercises I could work with my son to help improve my son's balance, coordination and stance. If anyone has any mobility/pain/functional issue, Tan Long is a great PT reach out to

reviews.name: Meraki Quartet
reviews.text: Just had my first session with Shaun and it was great! He was very professional and helpful, and I was very surprised that I was able to see improvement in my neck mobility issues within one session. Looking forward to getting stronger in time to come!

reviews.name: Stephanie Ng Chui Peng
reviews.text:
I've never been to a gym before, and my intention is to build muscle mass while retaining flexibility, as I'm 53 years old. I was also having some issues with lower back pain.
I booked a trial session with Shaun Lim today, which included a movement assessment, strength testing, and a short workout. Shaun was very patient and took the time to understand my concerns and explain in detail how each exercise could help. I especially appreciated that he also showed me some simple movements I could do at home to help myself.
I really appreciated his patience, guidance, and willingness to make sure I understood what I was doing. It was a very positive first experience for someone who has never been to a gym before.
Thank you, Shaun, for your patience, encouragement, and for making my first gym experience such a positive and comfortable one. I truly appreciate your guidance and look forward to learning more from you!

reviews.name: Streetfighter Yong
reviews.text: Jensen has been an excellent personal trainer who I have worked with for many years. He helped me strengthen and recover my knee after several injuries. He carefully tailored the exercises to my needs, helping me gradually rebuild my strength, stability and confidence. Beyond my knee recovery, his training has also greatly improved my overall fitness, strength and endurance. Jensen is knowledgeable, patient and attentive, and always ensures that I exercise with the correct technique. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a professional, supportive and dedicated personal trainer.

reviews.name: Pearly Lim
reviews.text: Before my rehab session with Tan Loong, found it difficult to do lotus seat without pain in the knee. During the first session, he carefully assessed my body condition and explained why and which areas are limiting my movement. He guided me through targeted exercises and adjusted the training according to how my body responded. What I found valuable was how attentive he was. He not only observed my movement closely, corrected my exercises, he also pointed out other problem areas to improve. I enjoyed his sessions as I saw tremendous improvement just after over 1 mth of training. He was recommended by my sister who has followed him for some time as she was progressing with his effective training methods.

reviews.name: Kheelee Seow
reviews.text:
I'm 58 years old this year. I always thought I was very healthy, so I didn't pay much attention to my diet, eating a little of everything, thinking it wouldn't matter. Later, a health check revealed my blood sugar was extremely high. The doctor recommended medication, but I wasn't keen on taking it at the time, so I took it intermittently.
One day, my right eye suddenly veered to the right, I saw two images, and I couldn't walk normally. A checkup at the Central Hospital revealed it was paralysis of the third nerve in my brain. An MRI confirmed the problem, and my life suddenly became very inconvenient. I had to stop working and focus on my health.
Later, I started working with a professional fitness coach. Through proper exercise, massage to relax my cervical spine, a healthy diet, and regular medication, my vision has returned to normal, I no longer experience walking pain, and even my knee pain has improved significantly.
I'm truly grateful to the professional team here; they not only provided training but also helped me regain a healthy life!
